description: The machine: GPUs, CPUs, memory, disks, network, temperatures and power.

panels.title: Memory used by programs

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)

panels.description: Memory that programs hold and the system cannot take back (100% minus MemAvailable). The models' files that the engine maps sit in the page cache, not here: Memory below shows it. options.content: SM activity, tensor cores, XID errors, ECC, retired pages and NVLink come from NVIDIA's DCGM exporter, the **dcgm** profile: `COMPOSE_PROFILES=dcgm` in `deploy/.env` (the installer offers it where NVIDIA's registry, nvcr.io, is reachable). Then the **GPU Hardware** dashboard shows them; without it its DCGM panels are empty.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: During GPU inference the CPU should be mostly idle. Sustained `user` or `system` load often means the model fell back to CPU, or tokenisation is the bottleneck.

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) / on() group_left count(count by (cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total))

panels.title: Per-core utilisation
panels.description: A single saturated core alongside idle ones usually means a single-threaded bottleneck rather than genuine CPU pressure.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - avg by (cpu) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])))

panels.title: NVMe temperature over time
panels.description: Each NVMe drive's composite temperature (SMART temp1) from node-exporter's hwmon collector, which reads the kernel's own nvme sensors -- node-exporter already mounts the host /sys, so no extra exporter is needed. A drive is named by its device, then the model it reports (node_nvme_info), as in nvme0 · <model>, or by its device alone when it reports no model. Some drives also report their NAND and controller as temp2/temp3, which the composite lags under sustained writes. SATA drives have no sensor here.

targets.expr: label_join(label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip=~"nvme_nvme[0-9]+",sensor="temp1"}, "device", "$1", "chip", "^nvme_(nvme[0-9]+)$") * on (instance, device) group_left (model) max by (instance, device, model) (node_nvme_info{model!=""}), "drive", " · ", "device", "model") or on (instance, chip) label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip=~"nvme_nvme[0-9]+",sensor="temp1"}, "drive", "$1", "chip", "^nvme_(nvme[0-9]+)$")
